notes: Priority fields: no Cmax, Tmax, AUC or absorption half-life are reported anywhere in the body; only elimination half-lives (t1/2,beta) are given. The Methods state that both distribution (t1/2,alpha) and elimination (t1/2,beta) half-lives were derived from a biexponential Origin 8 fit (t1/2 = 0.693*t), but no numerical t1/2,alpha value is printed. Internal inconsistency in the source: the Methods say the blood-circulation study used Kunming mice while the Fig. 4A caption says C57BL/6 mice - both recorded, neither resolved. The free-DOX half-life of ca. 0.2 h is explicitly flagged as 'data not shown'. The DOX-LPs value of 8.0 h is the authors' own measurement; the 20-30 h figure in the same sentence is cited literature for Doxil and was not measured here. Polymersome stability in cell culture medium containing 10% FBS was classified as in vitro rather than ex vivo because it is a formulation size-stability assay in culture medium, not a serum degradation assay. The PEPLIFE2 header row (PHSCN, 4.13 h elimination, Kunming mice, IV, 150 uL) matches the body text and was used only to know which peptide to look for.
